one_liner: A patient with a right lung mass invading the diaphragm and liver underwent a right thoracotomy, right lower lobectomy, and en bloc resection of the diaphragm and liver portion, and was transferred to the recovery room in stable condition.

problems.name: Right lung mass invading diaphragm and liver

key_findings.name: Right lower lobe lung mass invading diaphragm and liver
key_findings.interpretation: Mass involving diaphragm and dome of liver found intraoperatively

procedures.name: Right lower lobectomy with en bloc resection of diaphragm and portion of liver

course.narrative: The patient underwent a right thoracotomy and right lower lobectomy with en bloc resection of the diaphragm and a portion of the liver for a lung mass invading the diaphragm and liver. Intraoperatively, the inferior pulmonary vein was ligated, the right lower lobe bronchus was divided with a stapler, and the involved diaphragm and dome of the liver were resected using Bovie cautery. Hemostasis was achieved. A 10-flat JP drain was placed in the abdomen, a single 32 straight chest tube was placed, and the chest was closed. The patient was extubated and transferred to the recovery room in stable condition.
